{"claims":[{"claim_text":"DSA has endorsed the campaign to Demand Safe Schools launched by the United Teachers of Los Angeles (UTLA) and the Chicago Teachers Union (CTU).",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Demand Safe Schools is calling for a return to in-person learning only when the scientific data supports it.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Demand Safe Schools is calling for police-free schools.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Demand Safe Schools is calling for all schools to function as community schools with adequate numbers of counselors and nurses and community/parent outreach workers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Demand Safe Schools is calling for safe conditions including lower class sizes, PPE, cleaning, testing, and other key protocols.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[6]},{"claim_text":"Demand Safe Schools is calling for equitable access to online learning.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[6]},{"claim_text":"Demand Safe Schools is calling for support for communities and families, including a moratorium on evictions/foreclosures and providing direct cash assistance to those not able to work or who are unemployed.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[7]},{"claim_text":"Demand Safe Schools is calling for a moratorium on new charter or voucher programs and standardized testing.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[8]},{"claim_text":"Demand Safe Schools is calling for adequate and equitable funding through federal stimulus.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[9]},{"claim_text":"Demand Safe Schools is calling for a massive infusion of federal money to support reopening funded by taxing billionaires and Wall Street.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[10]},{"claim_text":"DSA will be in the streets on 8/3 for the Demand Safe Schools Day of Resistance to win these demands.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[11]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
